newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST-Italy money mkt sees fall in rates soon.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Italy money mkt sees fall in rates soon.

text.p: Italy's money market is even more hopeful of a fall in official interest rates in the short term, according to a weekly study of implicit rates carried out by the Bocconi University's research arm, Igier, for Reuters.
The study showed the market saw the overnight rate on a one-month to two-year horizon steady under 7.0 percent.
The market saw o/n at 6.94 percent in one month, down from the 7.24 percent forecast a week ago. On Thursday, the day Igier based its study, o/n stood at 7.05 percent.
On a three-month timeframe, the implicit overnight rate was seen at 6.78 percent, down from 7.03 percent seen a week ago and 7.30 percent one month ago.
On a one-year horizon, the implicit o/n rate was seen falling to 6.59 percent, down from 6.77 percent seen a week ago and 7.19 percent a month ago.
On a two-year view, the market saw o/n at 6.96 percent from 7.14 percent a week ago and 7.39 percent a month ago.

The spread between Italian and German implicit overnight rates on a two-year timeframe, considered a good indicator of market confidence in Italy's early entry into European and economic monetary union (EMU), was at 228 basis points, in from 234 bps a week ago and 252 bps a month ago.
